notes: Reports the generic product string "USB KEYBOARD" (SONiX), so it is never chosen automatically: an unrecognised AJAZZ-protocol keyboard can pick this screen size in the screen studio. 240×135 screen, at most 141 frames; the display only takes commands with the back switch on USB.

usb.evidence: dantje/ajazz-ak35i-v3-max PROTOCOL.md (MIT): time sync, lighting, per-key and screen upload on 0C45:8009.

2.4ghz.evidence: With the back switch on RF the display ignores commands (PROTOCOL.md §2).

bluetooth.evidence: With the back switch on BT the display ignores commands (PROTOCOL.md §2).
